description.text: Why choose to study this program? As one of the national key subjects, the Mechanical Manufacture and Automation focuses on multi-disciplinary, dedicates to the development the application of advanced manufacturing in the information industry, environmental engineering, life sciences and other fields. Please contact us before application to confirm whether this English-medium program would be open this year. Course Arrangement 1. It includes 6 Second Class Disciplines of mechanical manufacturing and automation, mechatronic engineering, mechanical design and theory, vehicle engineering, precision manufacturing engineering, and industrial engineering. 2. It integrates the information science and traditional mechanical manufacturing, and emphasizes on the knowledgeable, digital, integration, network, so as to realize the ascension from the traditional mechanical manufacturing to advanced manufacturing 3. It takes manufacturing science as the core, automation and precision as support, digital equipment, vehicle engineering, and information industry as carrier to develop the application of advanced manufacturing in information industry, environment engineering and life science. It achieves the “big manufacturers” in the ever-expanding multi-disciplinary and cross-disciplinary extension of mechanical engineering. Diploma Awarded Master's Degree Entry Requirements Applicants for Master’s degree must have obtained Bachelor’s Degree and be under the age of 35.

duration.text: The Mechanical Manufacture and Automation at Wuhan University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Health certificate Photocopy of notarized foreigner physical examination record (for durations of study over 6 months) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents 6. Undergraduate school transcript

requirements.text: 1. Aged 18 or above 2. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens in good health. 3. Hold a Bachelor's degree.
